data.name: Kranti
data.long_meaning: Kranti is a Sanskrit term that means revolution or change. It is derived from the root verb 'krant' which means to move or to change. In Hindu mythology, Kranti is associated with the god Vishnu, who is known as the preserver and the bringer of change. The name is also used for individuals who are agents of change and revolution.
